description: Claim presets SynthHub imported from another site (their page says 'imported', with the author's name and page there) when the user is that author: give the id of one of them; the server answers with a code for the user to add to their author page at that site (profile or bio). Once it is there, call again with verify: true: every preset imported from that author becomes the user's, to edit or withdraw.

id.description: Id of one of the imported presets.

user_id.description: Your anonymous SynthHub id, if you kept it from an earlier session (see the server instructions). Optional.

verify.description: True once the code is on the author page.

name: claim_presets
